title: Sistema Pool Tunich area, Xcaret - line plot (May 2013)
credits: Sistema Pool Tunich area, Xcaret, Quintana Roo, May 2013; AMCS Activities Newsletter 36, p. 99, 2013

trace.why: Line plot on white: survey lines in three colours - cyan (pre-2013 dry), red (2013 dry), green (underwater). Needs a 'cyan' test in survey_line_paths (min(g, b) - r >= minBlueExcess; 'blue' is b - max(r, g), which cyan fails as g = b): prototyped in the scratchpad's pt/trace_cyan.py. At 2.1 m/px the densest mazes (and the small red 2013 mazes, e.g. Cueva Chicleros) are solid blobs on the scan: their skeleton keeps only a few lines. joinShortPx 16 keeps the short junction-to-junction pieces of the mazes (at 8 m minimum they were dropped, leaving gaps). The grey circle ('unsurveyed dry passage') isn't a survey colour, so isn't traced: the two caves stay apart.

exclude.why: title block and colour legend (drawn in the survey colours)

controlPoints.name: Vasija cenote? (sat)
controlPoints.note: Hypothesis: the only open water-filled cenote (~20 m) visible on the satellite near where the map falls; Vasija Entrance is where the underwater (green) line meets the dry (red) one, so a pool.

controlPoints.name: tour clearing (sat)
controlPoints.note: Alternative hypothesis: a developed clearing (palapas, vehicles) on the dirt road from the Rio Secreto reception, ~220 m from the Mundo Perdido Entrance label's cave.

controlPoints.name: Rio Secreto (OSM/Wikipedia)
controlPoints.note: Rio Secreto = Sistema Pool Tunich (QRSS); this is the park's reception by Hwy 307, not a point on the map: the px is only a guess (the system's centre near the highway).

symbols.why: Line plot: no depths, letter codes, bones, flow arrows or 'To ...' leads are drawn. Kept: the cave names (place-name, on the cave each names) and the 'unsurveyed dry passage' note on its circle.

placement: WEAK, unverified. No database cave, GPS or drawn road/landmark: north (true, arrow N_T) and scale (1000 m bar, 2.123 m/px) come from the map; the position from one satellite hypothesis (Vasija Entrance = the only visible water cenote nearby). Sistema Pool Tunich is the Rio Secreto cave (QRSS), whose reception by Hwy 307 is ~200 m from the guessed system centre; the other hypothesis (Mundo Perdido Entrance = a tour clearing on the Rio Secreto dirt road) moves the map ~260 m west-north-west. Expect errors of a few hundred metres until an entrance GPS is known.
